Name: Incense Burner
Description: Wild creatures return to your floor twice as often. Burns for 30 days.

Name: Bait
Description: Wild creatures return in half the time. Stacks with Incense. Lasts 30 days.

Name: Auto PVP Attacks
Description: Ten more Auto PVP attacks. They join today's pool even above the daily ten and expire at the daily reset.

Name: First Incense
Description: Your first Incense: wild creatures return twice as often for 1 day. One time only.

Name: First Bait
Description: Your first Bait: wild creatures return in half the time for 1 day. Stacks with Incense. One time only.

Name: Scrap Key
Description: Opens the Rusted Dimension once: five floors of five battles that pay Scrap. Consumed on entry.

Name: Dust Key
Description: Opens the Enchanted Dimension once: five floors of five battles that pay Dust. Consumed on entry.

Name: Ichor Key
Description: Opens the Sanguine Dimension once: five floors of five battles that pay Ichor. Consumed on entry.

Name: Essence Key
Description: Opens the Swollen Dimension once: five floors of five battles that pay Essence. Consumed on entry.

Name: Ink Key
Description: Opens the Inscribed Dimension once: five floors of five battles that pay Ink. Consumed on entry.

Name: Tallow Candle
Description: A plain tallow candle for your shelf. Rest the pointer on it to light it. Yours for good.

Name: Beeswax Candle
Description: A ribbed beeswax candle that burns gold. Rest the pointer on it to light it. Yours for good.

Name: Void Candle
Description: A black candle from below the tower; its flame burns violet. Rest the pointer on it to light it. Yours for good.

Name: Name Change
Description: Change your hero's name once. Your old name is held for you for 30 days, and the next change waits 30 days.

Name: Brute
Description: Unlocks the Brute class at level 1 with its two Tier-1 weapons. Also sold for Scrap in the CLASSES window.

Name: Assassin
Description: Unlocks the Assassin class at level 1 with its two Tier-1 weapons. Also sold for Scrap in the CLASSES window.

Name: Professor
Description: Unlocks the Professor class at level 1 with its two Tier-1 weapons. Also sold for Ink in the CLASSES window.

Name: Mutant Paladin
Description: A mutant look for the Paladin: the same hero in the hue the tower twists its creatures into. Bought before stage 3 it waits as a preview and goes on at stage 3. Yours for good.

Name: Mutant Archon
Description: A mutant look for the Archon: the same hero in the hue the tower twists its creatures into. Bought before stage 3 it waits as a preview and goes on at stage 3. Yours for good.

Name: Mutant Hawkeye
Description: A mutant look for the Hawkeye: the same hero in the hue the tower twists its creatures into. Bought before stage 3 it waits as a preview and goes on at stage 3. Yours for good.

Name: Mutant Titan
Description: A mutant look for the Titan: the same hero in the hue the tower twists its creatures into. Bought before stage 3 it waits as a preview and goes on at stage 3. Yours for good.

Name: Mutant Nightblade
Description: A mutant look for the Nightblade: the same hero in the hue the tower twists its creatures into. Bought before stage 3 it waits as a preview and goes on at stage 3. Yours for good.

Name: Mutant Prophet
Description: A mutant look for the Prophet: the same hero in the hue the tower twists its creatures into. Bought before stage 3 it waits as a preview and goes on at stage 3. Yours for good.

Name: Mutant Skin Set
Description: All six mutant class skins at once, 15% off buying them one by one. Each goes on at its class's stage 3. Yours for good.

Name: Turbo Pens
Description: All your pens breed twice as fast. Each egg costs the same Ichor. Lasts 30 days.

Name: Lucky Charm
Description: Every kill rolls for gear a second time. The extra gear is bound to your account and cannot be sold on the market. Lasts 30 days.

Name: Complete Pack
Description: 30 days of every timed boon at once: Incense, Bait, Turbo Pens and Lucky Charm, 5% off buying them one by one. Each adds to the time it already has. Not a subscription: it never renews.

Name: Deluxe Pack
Description: 90 days of every timed boon at once: Incense, Bait, Turbo Pens and Lucky Charm, 10% off buying them one by one. Each adds to the time it already has. Not a subscription: it never renews.

Name: Breeder's Week
Description: 7 days of Turbo Pens and 7 days of Incense. The food stays yours to farm. Once a week; the week starts Monday at midnight UTC.

Name: XP Candy Key
Description: One key to the Candy Kitchen at the highest level you have opened: three fights that pay XP candy. XP candy is not a roll input, so this is the only resource key for sale. Three a day.

Name: Mutation Draught
Description: Turns one creature you own to its mutant palette. Cosmetic: its stats, grade and breeding stay its own, and the palette is removed if the creature is listed on the Steam market. Used from the creature's sheet.

Name: Gauntlet Entry
Description: One run of any gauntlet you have unlocked, on top of its free run each week. It waits in your bag: use it there or from the gauntlets window. Cannot be dismantled or sold.
